items.en: Russia strikes Ukraine overnight 16–17 October with Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr and 332 drones; no ballistic or Kh-22/32 missiles reported intercepted
items.nl: Rusland valt Oekraïne in nacht van 16 op 17 oktober aan met Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr en 332 drones; geen ballistische of Kh-22/32-raketten onderschept gemeld
items.sEn: On the night of 16–17 October Russia carried out a combined missile and drone attack on Ukraine, according to Ukraine's Air Force as reported by Ukrainska Pravda. It used Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles, Kh-22/32 cruise missiles, four sea-launched Kalibr cruise missiles and 332 Shahed (31 jet-powered) and Gerbera…

Daarbij werden ingezet: ballistische Iskander-M/KN-23-raketten, Kh-22/32-kruisvluchtwapens, vier vanaf zee gelanceerde Kalibr-kruisvluchtwapens en 332 Shahed…

items.en: «ПВО ВСУ в ночь на субботу не смогла перехватить ни одной ракеты ОТРК «Искандер»» (Topwar: 'Ukrainian air defence failed to intercept a single Iskander missile on Saturday night')
items.nl: Topwar: Oekraïense luchtverdediging onderschepte in nacht naar 17 oktober geen enkele Iskander
items.sEn: Topwar (author Yevgenia Chernova) describes the Russian combined strike on Ukraine in the night to 17 October. The figures come from the Ukrainian Air Force.
